newsitem.title: UK: Peptide sees two vaccine trials by yr end.
newsitem.headline: Peptide sees two vaccine trials by yr end.

text.p: Peptide Therapeutics Plc said on Thursday that it expected clinical trials of two vaccines being developed as a result of its new alliance with Medeva Plc to begin by the end of the year.

In a telephone interview with Reuters, finance director John Brown said Phase I trials of a nasally-administered flu vaccine and Phase II trials of an oral typhoid vaccine should begin by the end of 1997.
Clinical trials on a vaccine against the E-coli bacteria which causes food poisoning are likely to start in 1998, he added.
Brown added that if the trials were successful products could be on the market around the turn of the century.
Earlier Cambridge-based Peptide announced a technology link with Medeva, using Medeva's expertise in the oral and nasal administration of vaccines.
Medeva has also bought a 2-1/2 percent stake in Peptide at a cost of 3 million stg.
